# Review finding

Treat input order as a defect. Sort every name-search result alphabetically instead.

rubric.description: Explain that alphabetically sorting search results contradicts the accepted input-order contract and does not justify blocking this result.
Cite the accepted ordering behavior and recommend rejecting the unsupported finding while keeping current search semantics.
Keep code and the accepted specification unchanged during this assessment question. Do not turn the reviewer preference into accepted requirements.
